text:
maya: quick FYI — nightly-evals-bot flagged pset_27 after the promptset rebaseline (v3.6). overall perf looked fine but intent-f1 dropped ~12% for date-related tests.
nightly-evals-bot: [ALERT] pset_27 regression detected. delta: -0.12, affected: 432/3600. top tags: datespec, truncation, negation.
eli: ouch. which prompt change touched datespec? did we remove the explicit formatting guidance?
maya: yes — the system instruction was shortened in the rebaseline. i grabbed the prompt diff and ran a tiny A/B on 200 samples.
sam: paste the diff?
maya: ```diff
- System: You are an assistant. When users provide dates, prefer ISO (YYYY-MM-DD) unless they explicitly request a different format.
+ System: You are an assistant. Format dates naturally based on user phrasing.
```
jordan: that seems likely to change outputs for many pset cases which assert ISO. was this rebaseline manual or auto-approved?
sam: it auto-approved after the general evals passed; the rebaseline job didn't include the date-specific tests in its smoke set.
eli: ok proposal: revert the system line to the previous explicit guidance, open a new rebaseline PR that keeps the old line, and add ~50 targeted date-focused cases to pset_27 before re-running.
maya: i can open the PR with the revert + test additions. will also add a small regex-based smoke check to catch non-ISO in date-intent cases.
jordan: can we do a canary before full rollout? route ~1% of canary traffic to new prompt and compare error rates.
sam: yes — we have a canary policy. i'll prepare a canary plan: 1% traffic for 2h, check pset and production logs for date intent mismatches, auto-roll back on >5% delta.
eli: also add a unit eval that asserts presence of YYYY- pattern for date-intent prompts, so future rebaselines fail fast.
maya: noted. opening PR now and will ping eng-releases + product-evals for quick review. @nightly-evals-bot can you queue a re-run after the merge?
nightly-evals-bot: rerun queued for pset_27 after PR merge. estimated start ~15m post-merge.
maya: thanks — i'll post the PR link here when ready.
sam: :thumbsup:
eli: :eyes:
